open_points.subject: Linux-only release host restriction
open_points.text: A release runs on Linux and on no other host, no version named (owner, 2026-10-18).
open_points.question: What owns and enforces the Linux-only host restriction, given that State 3 assigns A20 rule 3 no runtime module and describes the external release artifact only as selecting, recording and verifying dependency and sandbox-runtime pins?
options: The external release/build process owns and enforces the host restriction
A runtime start-up module checks the host and refuses non-Linux systems
The restriction is documentation only and is not mechanically enforced
open_points.default_guess: The external release/build process owns and enforces the host restriction without a runtime host check.
